title: Condensed Matter Physics
content: Condensed matter physics explores the emergent properties of many-body systems in solid and liquid phases, where collective interactions yield unique quantum phenomena. Charting crystal lattices, electronic band structures, superconductivity, and topological insulators, this curriculum maps the macroscopic manifestation of quantum mechanics in structured matter.
